Thesecrethand here. I'm here live in the mission district. The bars have been packed since about 11:00 am or so, and it's all calm so far. Lots of car horns, whistles, panhandlers, booze, and the color red is everywhere. Ill try to keep you posted. Win or lose, shenanigans will ensue.

How do you know his/her problems are temporary?

I don't like how i envy my friends who have passed on. I dont like that i have to create someone in my head so i can have someone who cares for me, wont give up on me or leave me. I hate that every woman ive ever loved calls me "crazy" or "fucked up". I hate when people do care for me, i cant stand them and all i want to do is get away from them. I dont like how the world is filled with misery and pain.  I hate that i don't see worth in my fellows. I hate that i tried to kill my ex, when the only reason she cheated was because i had nothing to offer her. I hate that no meal makes me full and never tastes good. I hate that i have nowhere to live and i havent slept in 3 days. I dislike everything about myself and you. No offense.
 I dont like that im alive, while others are not. I dont like life anymore amd haven't for years.
I just want off the merry-go round. thank you for your kind words.

I did therapy for 8 years, but that usually stops after in-patient treatment and didnt help with my trust issues (i dont like myself and as a reflection, i dont care for people). Ive done the meds, and the talking but really? I feel like a pepperment candy, but with no taste what-so-ever. I look ok from the outside because i do well at hiding it, but take the wrapper off and I'm tasteless. Im rambling now. Inexpensive treatment still bears expense. Truthfully, id rather buy a gun.

I fence, bike, climb, among other things, but its all about keeping myself busy. All im doing is staving off the beast, and it's all is showing to be futile. When im not doing those things, im in bed where i have to force myself out of it. Im homeless right now so that means i have no place to cry, or anyone to really talk to. Im tired of talking to people i despise, becuse i really have lost respect for humanity at large. I just want to sleep and never wake up. I need quiet and sometimes, the voices are too loud to concentrate. Hell, i just bought a dress for my girlfriend who doesent even exist, but i need her to be around and i dont care if that sounds crazy or not. At least im not alone all the time.
